title: Reasoning Items are captured on the synchronous surface and stepped over in a batch
rationale: Under store:false each reasoning Item carries an opaque encrypted_content blob the NEXT request of a tool loop must replay verbatim, so the provider keeps them whole on Metadata. A batch line is a one-shot request with no next round inside the batch to replay them into, so the coordinator counts their tokens and nothing else. Either way the Items are never text: they must not leak into Content. An Item type neither surface asked for is stepped over rather than failing the turn.
